name: Alvium 1800 C-158c

sources.title: Alvium 1800 C-158 data sheet (Allied Vision, generated 2026-Nov-07)
sources.covers: sensor (Sony IMX273), chroma, resolution, shutter, sensor size and diagonal, pixel size, pixel formats, frame rate, exposure, power, size, lens mounts, mass, interface

note: A compact MIPI CSI-2 embedded camera (Alvium C); the data sheet covers the colour (C-158c, entered) and mono models. Sold without a lens, so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Sony IMX273, 1456 x 1088, global shutter, sensor "5 x 3.8 mm (6.3 mm, Type 1/2.9)", pixel 3.45 um. Maximum frame rate 262 fps; the data sheet does not say for which pixel format (RGB8 and RGB888 are its defaults, but 1456 x 1088 at 262 fps at 24 bits per pixel would be 9.96 Gbit/s, and the sheet gives no lane rate for its "up to 4 lanes"), so the stream's format and bits per pixel are null (not stated for that rate; truthfulness review 2026-11-07, data sheet read again). Exposure 28 us to 10 s. power_w is the typical 2.4 W (5 VDC over MIPI CSI-2). size_mm: 26 x 29 x 29 mm (L x W x H); C-, CS- or S-mount. Two programmable GPIOs (trigger use not stated, so sync is null).
